AiIndexingPolicy.description: AI indexing policy for a module.

CreateFromTemplateRequest.description: Request to create an object from a template.

CreateVaultRequest.description: Request to create a new vault.

secret.description: Optional HMAC signing secret (plain text; will be encrypted before storage).

CreatedObject.description: Result of creating an object from a template.

DeleteVaultFileRequest.description: Request to delete a file from a vault.

DispatchWebhookRequest.description: Request to dispatch an event to registered chat webhooks.

Event.description: Event stored in the event store

File.description:
File metadata for a user's uploaded file.

Files use content-addressed storage where the actual file content is stored
in object storage using the content hash as the key.

FileVersion.description:
A version snapshot of a file's content.

Each time a file is modified, a new version is created with the updated content hash.

FileWithShares.description: File with share information for list responses

share_expires_at.description: Earliest share expiration date (None if no shares have expiration)

Folder.description:
A folder that organizes files in a hierarchical structure.

Folders form a tree structure where each folder can have a parent folder.
The root folder has no parent.

ancestor_ids.description:
Ancestor folder IDs (parent, grandparent, etc.) for efficient permission resolution.
Stored as Option for backward compatibility with folders created before this field existed.

FolderContents.description:
A flat representation of folder contents.

Contains the files and immediate subfolders in a directory,
without recursing into subdirectories.

FolderTree.description:
A recursive representation of folder structure.

Contains a folder and all its subfolders recursively, along with files
at each level. This provides a complete tree view of the folder hierarchy.

FolderTreeNode.description: Folder tree node with share information for sidebar

FolderTreeWithShares.description: Folder tree response with share indicators

FolderWithShares.description: Folder with share information for list responses

share_expires_at.description: Earliest share expiration date (None if no shares have expiration)

size.description: Total recursive size of all non-deleted files within this folder (in bytes)

IncomingChatEvent.description: Incoming chat event from external chat system.

NoteSummary.description: Note summary for listings (includes file id but not full content).

Notification.description:
In-app notification for a user.

Notifications are persistent and stored in the database. They complement
real-time WebSocket notifications for offline users.

action_url.description: Optional deep link to the resource

ReceiveChatEventRequest.description: Request to receive a chat event from an external system.

RegisterWebhookRequest.description: Request to register a new webhook URL.

RenameVaultFileRequest.description: Request to rename a file within a vault.

ResourceType.description: Type of resource referenced by notification.

Share.description:
A share link that allows access to a file or folder.

Supports both public shares (anonymous access via token), user shares
(authenticated user-to-user sharing), and group shares (access via group membership).

access_count.description: Access count for public shares only

expires_at.description: Expiration time for public shares only

file_id.description: File being shared (None for folder shares)

folder_id.description: Folder being shared (None for file shares)

password_hash.description: Password hash for public shares only

recipient_group_id.description: Recipient group for group shares (None for public/user shares)

recipient_user_id.description: Recipient user for user shares (None for public/group shares)

share_token.description: Token for public shares (None for user shares)

upload_only.description: Public folder share that allows uploads but not browsing/downloads.

SharePermissions.description: Permission level for a share link.

ShareReceivedByUserPayload.description: Share received by user event payload

ShareRecipient.description:
Represents a recipient of a share (for API responses).

Used in GET /api/shares/{id}/recipients endpoint.

ShareRevokedFromUserPayload.description: Share revoked from user event payload

ShareType.description: Type of share (determined by which fields are set)

Template.description: A template configuration for creating module objects.

TemplateDefaultFile.description: A default file entry within a template.

UnfurlLinkRequest.description: Request to unfurl a RustShare link.

secret.description: `Some("")` clears the secret; `None` keeps existing; `Some(non_empty)` replaces.

User.description:
User account information.

Note: The `username` field is used for login and is distinct from `email`.
This allows users to have a stable login identifier separate from their email address.

email_sharing_enabled.description: Whether email can be shared with other users

trash_retention_days.description: Trash retention period in days (None = never auto-delete)

VaultAdapter.description: Adapter types supported for vault sync.

VaultDevice.description: A device authorized to sync a vault.

VaultFile.description: Metadata for a file inside a vault.

VaultManifest.description: A manifest representing the current state of a vault.

VaultManifestEntry.description: An entry in a vault manifest.

WebhookDispatchResult.description: Result of a single webhook dispatch.

secret.description: `"***"` when a secret is stored; `null` when none is set.
